name: No Means No Worldwide
summary: Writes the No Means No course (formerly IMPower), which teaches girls to recognise, avoid and resist sexual assault and boys to respect consent, and trains local partners and teachers to give it in Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Uganda, South Africa and other countries.
